retainedExplicitHolds.reason: Existing Spanish sense follow a treatment does not by itself establish successful healing; obtain a precise additional result-state lexical anchor before using that supplemental sense as proof.
Causative English cause to freeze is not inchoative Spanish become ice; already-covered-word redundant sense also deprioritized.
Assign another person a seat reverses the selected settling subject; do not treat as reciprocal/reflexive landing.
Ejaculation and orgasm are distinct; selected Spanish ejaculation sense alone is not confirmation of the orgasm synset.
Throw away an external object does not match get free oneself or mechanism dislocation.
Explicit ROSARSE→SONROSARSE alias exists, but SONROSARSE itself points to SONROSAR. Full exact three-record chain remains unbound in this subset; no positive source identity invented.

guards: Static whole-word lexical English only; no SE stripping, suffix decomposition, finite generation or clitic-template authority.
Keep actual selected role/voice and supporting-source regional/register context visible, with source links to the base/synonym proofs.
